data.one_liner: A flutter plugin for scanning 2D barcodes and QRCodes via camera.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that provides a simple wrapper around iOS and Android libraries to scan 2D barcodes and QR codes. It handles camera permissions and provides options to control flash and restrict barcode formats.
use_when: You need a straightforward, modal-based barcode and QR code scanner.
You need to quickly capture barcode string data with minimal UI customization.
avoid_when: You need an embedded widget preview inside your own custom UI rather than a full-screen scanner view.
You want a pure Dart implementation without native library wrappers.
strengths: Simple API with a single `BarcodeScanner.scan()` method call.
Built-in permission handling and flash control options.
weaknesses: Relies on older underlying native libraries (MTBBarcodeScanner and barcodescanner).
Limited to full-screen scanning flows rather than embedded widget views.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding CAMERA permission to AndroidManifest.xml and NSCameraUsageDescription to Info.plist on iOS. Android requires Kotlin configuration.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a widget-based scanner view that can be embedded anywhere in your widget tree.

alternatives.name: google_mlkit_barcode_scanning
alternatives.why_pick_it: Uses Google's ML Kit for powerful on-device barcode and QR code detection.
